name: Distance to Natural Quadrics
definition: Signed distance functions for standard solid modeling primitives (Plane, Sphere, Cylinder, Cone, Torus). These are less efficient than closed-form solutions for simple primitives but useful for higher-order constructions like blends and deformations.
summary: Distance to Natural Quadrics provides closed-form signed distance functions for planes, spheres, cylinders, cones, and tori, distinguishing itself by offering direct analytical solutions in the standard Euclidean metric.
